name: web-decision
description: Curated browser-local decision models running on TVM

scripts.test:kanana-runtime: tsc --project tsconfig.kanana-runtime.json && tsc --project tsconfig.kanana-runtime-tests.json && node --import tsx --test test/kanana-tvm-runtime.test.mts
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --src src --include=src/** --extension .js --extension .cjs --extension .mjs --extension .ts --extension .tsx --extension .jsx --extension .mts --extension .cts --exclude-after-remap --exclude=src/*.d.ts --exclude=src/**/*.d.ts --exclude=src/*.d.mts --exclude=src/**/*.d.mts --exclude=src/*.d.cts --exclude=src/**/*.d.cts --check-coverage --lines 85 --branches 80 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary node --import tsx ../../scripts/kanana/run-node-tests.mts && node --import tsx ../../scripts/ci/check-uncovered.ts
